purpose: Document official city-specific registry evidence, bounded anonymous geometry review and remaining coverage/runtime limits.
assessment: Rajasthan’s official Citizen UDH Urban GIS portal exposes Khasra, Plot and urban-jurisdiction map layers and states that Khasra/village boundaries come from the Settlement Department. The official state annual report says citizens can view Khasra boundaries and RoR information for urban properties. The application shell does not establish a full-vector response schema or whether the WUP point is covered by a parcel layer.

searchQueries.result: Official Rajasthan Citizen UDH offers Khasra/plot layers and a state report describes viewing Khasra boundaries and RoR for urban properties. Full geometry schema and exact-point coverage were not verified.

searchQueries.query: Ajmer Rajasthan official urban GIS Khasra cadastral maps land records
searchQueries.result: Rajasthan government materials identify Citizen UDH map layers for Khasra and urban plots; no anonymous full-polygon response schema was verified.

serviceChecks.method: GET official Rajasthan Citizen UDH shell
serviceChecks.observation: Official page exposes District and City/ULB selectors, coordinate-based map positioning, Khasra search, Khasra/Plot layers and states source khasra/village boundaries are Settlement Department data. No feature schema/full-vector response was inspected; direct local shell fetch timed out, which is inconclusive about provider availability.

serviceChecks.method: GET official Rajasthan DoIT&C annual report
serviceChecks.observation: Describes Citizen UDH views for Khasra boundaries, ward, forest, RoR and police boundaries for urban properties; it describes a map-view workflow rather than vector API.

serviceChecks.method: GET Government of India DILRMP Ajmer status page
serviceChecks.observation: Identifies Ajmer district and reports cadastral-map digitization/georeferencing status by tehsil; does not provide parcel geometries.
